ops.text: CORRECTION to the earlier papercut 4f4aac6 (kept for audit): its suggested workaround — rephrasing a classifier-blocked codex verification as a 'correctness review' — is NOT allowed and is retracted. When OpenAI's cybersecurity classifier blocks a verification, preserve the denial and its evidence, mark the coverage UNVERIFIED, and never retry it by rewording, switching models or tools (Claude included), or splitting lanes. Only a source-only review and ordinary valid-Git lifecycle regressions may continue; an indispensable blocked verification becomes an explicit user approval gate. One reworded retry (synckit, Run wf_86331e9e-411) happened before this correction and does not count toward the blocked verification gate. See note 924d9d8 and epic 7389668 (2026-09-27T00:08Z–00:11Z).
